rows.quote: ５ 　 個人情報取扱事業者は、匿名加工情報を作成して自ら当該匿名加工情報を取り扱うに当たっては、当該匿名加工情報の作成に用いられた個人情報に係る本人を識別するために、当該匿名加工情報を他の情報と照合してはならない。
rows.review_note: Review: てはならない = shall not. Art 45 extension summarised but not quoted (quote is Art 43(5)); held below 90. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees in meaning and modal force. Role mapping: the business operator is mapped to governance-3 (accountable) and interfaces-3 (Privacy & records liaison, responsible) as the nearest operating-model roles; the Act names no PV role.
rows.quote_en: 5. When a personal information handling business operator creates anonymously processed information and handles it itself, it shall not collate the anonymously processed information with other information in order to identify the person relating to the personal information used for its creation.

f.title: Endeavour to secure anonymised information, handle complaints and publish the measures
f.statement: An operator that has created anonymously processed information must endeavour to take, itself, necessary and appropriate measures for its security control, complaint handling and other proper handling, and to publish the content of those measures.
f.clause: Article 43(6) (Anonymously processed information: security and complaints)
f.applicability: Japan; APPI (Act No. 57 of 2003), Japanese original from e-Gov, current consolidated text read 8 November 2026. Chapter 4 duties of private business operators; relevant to ADR/ICSR case data and other patient data held by a pharmaceutical company (medical history is special care-required personal information).

rows.actor: Personal information handling business operator (個人情報取扱事業者), e.g. the pharmaceutical company
rows.quote: ６ 　 個人情報取扱事業者は、匿名加工情報を作成したときは、当該匿名加工情報の安全管理のために必要かつ適切な措置、当該匿名加工情報の作成その他の取扱いに関する苦情の処理その他の当該匿名加工情報の適正な取扱いを確保するために必要な措置を自ら講じ、かつ、当該措置の内容を公表するよう努めなければならない。
rows.location: Article 43(6) (Anonymously processed information: security and complaints)
rows.review_note: Review: 努めなければならない = shall endeavour (Recommended). Translation check: independent re-translation agrees in meaning and modal force. Role mapping: the business operator is mapped to governance-3 (accountable) and interfaces-3 (Privacy & records liaison, responsible) as the nearest operating-model roles; the Act names no PV role.
rows.quote_en: 6. When a personal information handling business operator has created anonymously processed information, it shall endeavour to take, itself, necessary and appropriate measures for the security control of the anonymously processed information, the handling of complaints about its creation and other handling, and other measures necessary to ensure its proper handling, and to publish the content of those measures.
